content:
A woman claiming to have had a romantic relationship with former *America's Got Talent* contestant and pastor Caleb Flynn has revealed shocking details about their relationship. Flynn is now accused of murdering his wife Ashley Flynn.

Alleigha Botner took the stand on Wednesday and Thursday in Miami County, Ohio, to testify in the Flynn case. During her testimony on Thursday, the 24-year-old read aloud text messages she says were sent to her by the 40-year-old Caleb Flynn. In some of the messages, Flynn expressed a wish for his wife to "disappear," even if it meant "ruining my daughters' lives."

"You know how much I hate her." Caleb Flynn wrote in one of the messages about Ashley Flynn, footage obtained by local NBC affiliate WLWT shows. "I can't stand to even see her or hear her name."

Botner became visibly emotional on the stand as she read aloud a shocking exchange.

"I wish I had never said that," she told the court before reading aloud a message she sent to Caleb Flynn: "I want to kill her, Caleb."

Caleb Flynn's reply, she quoted, was: "He said: 'Then we'll figure it out together.'"

Botner, who now works as a marketing specialist, said she met Caleb Flynn in 2022 while interning at his church.

Watch a clip of Botner's testimony from WLWT below.

Although she knew Caleb Flynn was married and had met his wife, she claimed the two began having a sexual relationship in May 2024.

According to WLWT, Botner said she and Caleb Flynn had been discussing their future together up until the day before Ashley Flynn's death, February 15.

"Alleigha, I love you. If you give me one more chance, I will love you until I die," Botner quoted one of Flynn's messages from that day. She also said Flynn later wrote: "I choose you, Alleigha. You are more than enough. Good night."

Ashley Flynn, 37, was found shot dead on February 16 at the home she shared with Caleb Flynn in Tipp City, Ohio. The couple's two daughters, then just nine and 11 years old, were asleep at the time.

Authorities were called to the scene after Caleb Flynn reported the incident. He told a 911 dispatcher that someone had broken into the home in the middle of the night and killed his wife.

Three days later, Caleb Flynn was arrested and charged with murder, two counts of felonious assault and two counts of tampering with evidence. He has pleaded not guilty to all charges.

Caleb Flynn, a native of Ohio, appeared on season 12 of *America's Got Talent*, which aired in 2013. He was eliminated early in the competition and did not advance to the live shows.

A brief interview with Caleb Flynn is posted on the official *America's Got Talent* YouTube channel. In it, he said he loved his wife "to death" and named Carrie Underwood as his favourite *Got Talent* champion.
